# intenter setup claude

Detect Claude Code, install the hooks and start the daemon

Installs Intenter's permission hooks into Claude Code, initializes the
local database, registers and starts the daemon, adds the terminal update
check, and verifies the whole path end to end with a dry-run evaluation.
Your Claude settings file is backed up first, hooks you already have are
kept, and entries left by a pre-rename development install are replaced.
Claude Code reads its hooks at start-up, so restart running sessions after.

## Usage

```text
intenter setup claude [flags]
```

## Examples

```console
intenter setup claude
intenter setup claude --dry-run
intenter setup claude --no-startup-check
```

## Options

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | — | print the planned changes without making any |
| `--no-service` | — | skip service registration and start the daemon manually |
| `--no-startup-check` | — | do not add the update check to your shell start-up files |
| `--settings` `<string>` | — | override the Claude settings file |
